title: Cascade accept for feature and epic review
summary:
Accepting a feature or epic in Review will complete every eligible child still in review, then the container—so reviewers can close a whole slice in one action instead of accepting tasks one by one.
- Accept cascades to linked tasks (and epic features) in `review`; reject stays single-ticket
- Accept enabled only when every descendant is `review` or terminal; blocks `todo`/`ready`/`in_progress`
- Extends tkt_01ks6810 layered review; parent completes only when all children are ready

Main risk is mid-batch parent demotion from `maybePromoteOrDemoteContainers`—suppress reconciliation during bundle moves.
context: User wants Accept on a feature or epic in Review to also accept all child tasks (and, for epics, child features) when every descendant is already `completed` or `review`. This extends parent feature tkt_01ks6810f8qgk82fbeh7wfbqga, whose four child tasks shipped non-cascade Accept/Reject UI. Clarification: a parent feature or epic may move to Completed only when no linked work remains in active workflow columns (`todo`, `ready`, `in_progress`, etc.).
researchFindings: `acceptReviewTicket` in `src/renderer/src/App.tsx` (~L4656) calls `moveTicketTo(RELAY_COMPLETED_STATUS)` for only the opened ticket; `getContainerTicketStatusNote` (~L1973) says Accept moves only the container.
`getTicketReviewActionState` (~L1955) shows Accept/Reject for task/feature/epic in `review` with no child-eligibility check.

`featureReadyForReview` / `epicReadyForReview` in `src/domain/boardReview.ts` use `isTerminalTaskStatus` only—`review` does not satisfy promotion; `epicReadyForReview` requires every linked feature `completed`.

`maybePromoteOrDemoteContainers` in `src/storage/boardReconciliation.ts` runs after every task `moveTicket` (`filesystem.ts` ~L1978); sequential task completes can demote a parent feature from `review` to `todo` mid-batch.
Archive bundles bottom-up via `archiveBundleForFeature`, `archiveBundleForEpic`, `sortArchiveBundleIds` in `src/renderer/src/lib/boardArchive.ts`; `archiveBundle` in `App.tsx` iterates sorted ids.
SPEC.md §5.5.1 (~L488–492) documents non-cascade container accept; must be updated for cascade accept while keeping task-only and reject paths unchanged.
Tests: `tests/board-review.test.ts` (gates), `tests/ticket-draft-ui.test.tsx` (~L774, non-cascade copy), `tests/backend.test.ts` (~L5361, feature promotion on task complete).
requirements: When a feature in `review` is accepted, move every linked task in `review` to `completed`, then move the feature to `completed`; leave tasks already terminal unchanged.
When an epic in `review` is accepted, move every linked feature in `review` (and their tasks in `review`) to `completed`, then move the epic to `completed`.

Enable Accept only when the container is in `review` and every linked descendant is `review` or terminal (`completed`, `not_doing`, `archive`, or a column with `terminal: true`); descendants in `todo`, `ready`, or `in_progress` disable Accept with clear copy.
Reject on feature/epic stays non-cascade (only the opened container moves to `completed`).
Task Accept remains single-ticket; accepting a task must not auto-accept its parent feature or epic.

Align container promotion gates with bulk-accept eligibility: treat child `review` like terminal for `featureReadyForReview`; treat features `review` or `completed` (and tasks review-or-terminal) for `epicReadyForReview`.
Update SPEC.md §5.5.1 and supersede non-cascade acceptance criteria on parent feature tkt_01ks6810f8qgk82fbeh7wfbqga.
implementationPlan: Update `featureReadyForReview` / `epicReadyForReview` in `src/domain/boardReview.ts` to count child `review` as satisfying promotion; keep demotion when a child leaves review-or-terminal.
Extend `ticketMoveInputSchema` with optional `suppressContainerReconciliation`; in `moveTicket` skip `maybePromoteOrDemoteContainers` when true for task moves.
Wire `acceptReviewTicket` in `App.tsx` to compute bundle ids, loop `moveTicketMutation` with suppression on task moves, then move the container; disable Accept when eligibility fails.
Replace `getContainerTicketStatusNote` review copy to describe cascade accept; keep reject copy non-cascade.
Update SPEC.md §5.5.1 container accept bullets to document cascade scope and eligibility.
testPlan: `node tests/run-tests.mjs tests/board-accept.test.ts` — bundle ordering, eligibility, accept-only-`review` ids.
`node tests/run-tests.mjs tests/board-review.test.ts` — promotion when all children `review` or terminal; demotion on reopen.
`node tests/run-tests.mjs tests/ticket-draft-ui.test.tsx` — updated container review notes and accept eligibility wiring.
`node tests/run-tests.mjs tests/backend.test.ts` — bulk feature accept completes review tasks + feature without mid-batch parent demotion.
acceptanceCriteria: Feature in Review with all tasks `review` or terminal: Accept completes every task still in `review`, then the feature; board shows no review-blocked children.
Epic in Review with all features `review` or `completed` and all tasks `review` or terminal: Accept completes nested review tickets, then the epic.
Any linked task in `todo`, `ready`, or `in_progress` disables Accept and shows why in detail copy.
Reject on feature/epic in Review moves only that container to `completed`; child tasks/features unchanged.
Task Accept still moves only the opened task.
SPEC §5.5.1 matches cascade accept behavior; parent feature tkt_01ks6810 acceptance criteria updated or marked superseded.
assumptions: Parent feature tkt_01ks6810 is not auto-moved to Completed as part of implementation; it completes only via normal gates when every descendant is `review` or terminal (per clarification).
Bulk-accept scope moves only descendants with `status === review`; already-terminal children are left as-is.
Promotion gates and bulk-accept eligibility both treat child `review` as ready (user: complete or in review).
Reject path and workspace revert-on-reject remain out of scope.
Implementation loops existing `moveTicket` with `suppressContainerReconciliation` rather than a new HTTP route.
implementationNotes: Supersedes non-cascade Accept criteria on tkt_01ks6810f8qgk82fbeh7wfbqga; child tasks tkt_01ks68bhm* remain the storage/UI/SPEC foundation.
Container `moveTicket` already skips reconciliation; only task moves in the accept loop need suppression.

leanTasks.title: Accept bundle and promotion-gate domain helpers
leanTasks.summary:
Introduce accept-bundle and eligibility helpers and align promotion gates with review-or-terminal children.
- New `boardAccept` domain module + renderer re-export
- `featureReadyForReview` / `epicReadyForReview` count child `review`
- Unit tests for bundles and eligibility
leanTasks.context: Foundation for cascade accept; mirrors `boardArchive.ts` bundle shape.
leanTasks.goal: Pure functions compute accept bundles, eligibility, and updated promotion gates without UI or storage changes.
requirements: Add accept bundle builders and `sortAcceptBundleIds` (tasks before features before epics).
Eligibility: all linked tasks `review` or terminal; epic also requires features `review` or `completed`.
Bundles include only ticket ids with `status === review` plus the container id last.
Update `featureReadyForReview` / `epicReadyForReview` to treat child `review` as satisfying gates.
acceptanceCriteria: `tests/board-accept.test.ts` passes for feature/epic bundles and blocked eligibility.
`tests/board-review.test.ts` passes with updated promotion cases for all-`review` children.
implementationPlan: Create `src/domain/boardAccept.ts` with eligibility and bundle helpers using `linkedTasksForFeature` / `linkedFeaturesForEpic`.
Update `src/domain/boardReview.ts` promotion helpers to use review-or-terminal checks.
assumptions: Bundle membership uses the same linked-child resolution as `boardReview.ts`.

leanTasks.title: Suppress reconciliation during bulk accept moves
leanTasks.summary:
Prevent `maybePromoteOrDemoteContainers` from demoting parents while accepting a review bundle.
- Optional `suppressContainerReconciliation` on `TicketMoveInput`
- `moveTicket` honors flag for task moves
- Backend test for multi-task feature accept
leanTasks.context: Mid-batch demotion is the main regression risk when completing review tasks sequentially.
leanTasks.goal: Storage supports sequential accept-bundle moves without parent demotion between task completions.
requirements: Add `suppressContainerReconciliation?: boolean` to `ticketMoveInputSchema`.
When true on a task move, skip `maybePromoteOrDemoteContainers` after `transitionTicketStatus`.
Default behavior unchanged when flag omitted.
acceptanceCriteria: Accepting two review tasks then a review feature leaves the feature in `completed`, not demoted to `todo` mid-batch.
implementationPlan: Add backend integration test: feature in `review`, two tasks in `review`, sequential completes with suppression, then feature complete.
assumptions: No new dedicated HTTP route required if UI passes the suppress flag on each bundle task move.
